propositions: Cross-level traversal must be confined: a direct edge from one graph level to another should not be traversed by cycle detection, even if the target is the queried source node.
Multi-hop traversal at different levels must not reconnect same-level nodes: an epic → task → epic dependency chain should not be detected as a cycle at the epic level.

Tombstone stubs with non-terminal recorded status must be loaded when reduce returns None: an open-status tombstone for an unreducible blocker should yield a status-only stub that keeps the target blocked.
Tombstone status must override the reduced status when both are present: a tombstone recording deleted status should override an open-status directory and unblock the target.
Malformed tombstone bytes must degrade to deleted rather than absent: unparseable tombstone data should be treated as closed (deleted) for unblock detection, not as missing.
